busUnreachable: the bus is unreachable — is `harbard serve` running?
handoffNeedsOneSession: Handoff needs one live session under To — Everyone on the bus can't close an ack.
channelHasNoMembers: That channel has no members — join it or pick another destination.
checkoutHeldByAnother: Another writer holds that checkout — wait or use a different worktree.
busCouldNotReadThread: the bus could not read that thread ({status})
